<div class="card-body">
'''Return Of A Jedi''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ジェダイの帰還</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらか選ぶこと。１：オビ＝ワンがロストデッキに送られる際に、１フォース消費して使う。ロストデッキからオビ＝ワンを取り戻す。２：３フォース消費してリザーブデッキから探し出し、手札に加える。その際、デッキは切り直すこと。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-107o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「どこで、あんなおいぼれを見つけたんだ？」「生きているはずなどないさ。」「もう死んでいるはずだ。」「いや、まだ死んではおらんさ。」そう、オビは帰ってきた！</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Return of a Jedi.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. When Obi-Wan is sent to the Lost Pile, use 1 Force to retrieve him. Or use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck, take Obi-Wan into hand, and shuffle.

'''Lore:''' “Where did you dig up that old fossil?” “He can't still be alive.” “He must be dead by now.” “No, he's not dead yet.” Obi is back!

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese numbers the two options.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Return Of A Jedi]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
